title: The Unicorn
seo_title: Unicorn Charcuterie Board: Rainbow Mane & Shopping List
description: A unicorn charcuterie board for 12 to 15: a cream cheese and feta unicorn head with a string cheese horn and a rainbow mane of berries, cheese and prosciutto.
hook: A unicorn with a mane like a rainbow, made of berries, cheese and prosciutto.
why: The head is spread like frosting: cream cheese whipped with feta, smoothed into a unicorn's profile on a white board. A twisted string cheese makes the horn.

The mane is where the color comes in: rows of raspberries, orange and yellow cheddar, green grapes, blueberries and pink prosciutto in rainbow order. It's a favorite for kids' birthdays because it's familiar food arranged in a magical way.

timeline.what: Whip the cheese for the head and cut the cheese cubes. Draw and cut the head template.
Spread the head and shape the horn.
Lay the rainbow mane from the head outward, then fill the edges.
Add the edible flowers and the cheek.

faq.q: How do you make a unicorn charcuterie board?
faq.a: Spread a cream cheese and feta mixture into a unicorn head, add a string cheese horn, then build the mane in rainbow rows of fruit, cheese and meat.

faq.q: Is this good for a kids' party?
faq.a: Yes. Most of it is mild cheddar, ham, salami, berries and grapes. Halve grapes lengthwise for children under 5.

Mix the cream cheese and feta and cube the cheese the day before. Keep meat, cheese and cut fruit out no more than 2 hours, or 1 hour above 90°F. For a long party, build half, keep the refill in the fridge and top it up halfway through.
